lines.text_source: "Grass and rocks,[01]huh?[02]I guess they come in[01]all shapes and sizes[01]then.[02]I wonder what a[01]dragon made of grass[01]would look like?[02]Now that I think of[01]it, there's a really[02]strange looking rock[01]over in the [05][02]quarry[06][01]to the south...[02]Maybe you should go[01]look and see if it's[02]one of those[01]dragons you're[01]talking about."

lines.base_translation: "Plantas e rochas, eh?[02]Acho que vem em todos[01]os tamanhos e jeitos[01]entao.[02]Fico pensando como seria[01]um dragao feito de plantas[02]eh?[02]Agora que penso, tem uma[02]rocha bem estranha[01]la na [05][02]pedreira[06][01]pro sul...[02]Talvez vcs deviam ir[01]ver se eh um dos[01]dragoes que vcs tao[01]falando."

lines.text_source: "Traveling, huh?[02]Well, to tell the[01]truth, I've never[01]gotten very far.[02]Guess you could say[01]I'm kind of a[01]homebody.[02]What about you?[01]Where're you[01]from?"[12][05][0C][93]Across the sea[01]Yesterday[01]Never mind

lines.text_source: "Wow! You're pretty[01]far from home then,[01]aren't you?[02]I bet you've seen[01]a lot of things[01]then."[12][06][0C][94]We've met dragons[01]We've flown[01]Chased by the Empire[01]Never mind
